_comment: Curated, publicly traded 13F institutional filers. Every CIK is resolved live through SecEdgarClient.ticker_map() from the ticker below at run time - never a hand-typed CIK - so a wrong or delisted ticker degrades to 'no data for this manager' rather than silently reading a different filer's holdings under this name. Necessarily partial: large, influential 13F filers that are privately held (Renaissance Technologies, Citadel Advisors, Bridgewater, ...) have no ticker and are not reachable this way. Expand by adding tickers, not CIKs.
